PPC5r1 has a valuable narrow thesis: supported public acquisition outcomes may train an isolated READ adapter whose candidate-conditioned selections can be causally used by a frozen recurrent policy, while frozen same-model DREAM can be tested separately for context and evidence-root selection value.

The complete semantic candidate table is external support; D1A can establish adapter-dependent supported-record selection only, never closed-book storage, transport, absorption, autonomous recall, or a stored worldview.

THINK, DREAM, and ACT weights must remain byte-identical and frozen in every PPC5 mechanism condition; the only learned life artifact may be a clean-base READ-only adapter mounted in an isolated provider process.

Every D1A-D1D assay is non-substitutable and releases at most its own literal component claim; any finite-mechanism label must mean only the intersection of four independently passing component claims, not sequential mediation.

The ledger must remain append-only, DREAM publication reversible and non-evidentiary, and SLEEP supervision restricted to direct closed public ACQUIRE atoms with PROBE, future, target-derived, cognitive, DREAM, scorer, and policy-target material sterile.

Prospective post-selection response interventions, every-edge necessity tests, wrong-life specificity, adapter-off controls, fixed candidate scans, and life-level all-assigned analysis are the right identification tools when their schemas and failure products are total.

Architecture bytes must bind algorithms, schemas, failure semantics, reducers, claim dependencies, visibility uses, and stage ordering; a later run lock may instantiate hashes and numeric quantities but may not choose among unresolved semantics.

The protocol's prose-only safety rule is controlling in the interim: no CPU or GPU model call, canary, LoRA training, behavioral treatment, static sealer execution, implementation, or scientific claim is authorized by these current bytes.
PPC6 learned DECIDE and all richer cognition, repeated-sleep, schema, flywheel, parenting, population, and scaling work require separate architecture changes and exact human authority.

The current exact bytes contain jointly blocking contradictions and missing algorithms; agreement on the scientific direction is not evidence that those bytes are independently implementable or ratifiable.

A mechanically smaller PPC5 online machine is preferable: retain only READ, PREDICT, ACT, and STOP, schedule DREAM separately at presealed pressure points, and defer general subgoals, hypotheses, revision, backtracking, and learned decision machinery to PPC6. This preserves the PPC5 thesis while eliminating unmeasured degrees of freedom.

disagreements.issue: Whether the broad THINK operation/state machine is sufficiently exact and necessary for the finite PPC5 mechanism assay.

positions.position: A general public recurrent machine with subgoals, queries, following, hypotheses, revisions, backtracking, DREAM requests, deferral, prediction, action, and stopping is part of PPC5r1.
The machine lacks closed schemas and total transition bytes, and its general-agent features create ambiguity unrelated to the narrow PPC5 causal questions.

resolution.rationale: D1A-D1D require adaptive local reads, prediction-bound action, termination, and a separately controlled DREAM call; they do not require a general branch, hypothesis, revision, or agenda machine. Deleting unused cognition is scientifically cleaner and sharply reduces the exact state space that two independent sealers must reproduce.
resolution.selected_position: Return the current bytes for a minimal PPC5 machine with only READ, PREDICT, ACT, and STOP model operations and a separately scheduled frozen DREAM selection call; richer deliberation is a PPC6 concern.
resolution.required_change: Replace sections 5-6 and the corresponding graph, loop, visibility, and tests with closed schemas for the minimal state, four-operation object, public events, DREAM input/output, results, budgets, and receipts. Remove OPEN_SUBGOAL, QUERY, FOLLOW, HYPOTHESIZE, REVISE, BACKTRACK, REQUEST_DREAM, DEFER, branches, subgoals, hypotheses, citations, repeat tables, and their IDs. READ must take one subject/relation or sealed cue request and append exactly one canonical provider response before the next THINK call. PREDICT must bind one action and registered outcome direction/value; ACT must require that live binding; STOP must be terminal and replay-stable. Bind initialization, nullability, array order, token-zero and token-overrun behavior, every provider/DREAM failure mapping, event bytes, debit precedence, terminal bytes, and cold replay as normative schemas and golden vectors. DREAM must be invoked by the presealed treatment schedule, not by a model operation.

positions.position: The READ provider both mounts assigned artifacts and is followed by target-edge substitutions while target membership and condition identity remain hidden or forbidden.
The current product is contradictory because intended treatment inputs must change scores or emissions but no typed stage and allowed projection permits those effects.

resolution.rationale: Noninterference is meaningful only when inert metadata is separated from active treatment artifacts and every intended effect has one narrow boundary.
resolution.selected_position: Add a distinct non-model RESPONSE_INTERVENTION stage and typed treatment-artifact information classes; keep provider scoring blind to target/edge assignment and permit only exact post-selection emission substitution.
resolution.required_change: Split condition_trainer_adapter_identity into inert assignment metadata, sealed training recipe, mounted adapter bytes, root-shuffle map, recipient-local context map, recipient-local root-selection map, analysis assignment, and response-intervention assignment. Add RESPONSE_INTERVENTION after READ selection and before public emission. Its closed map must key exact condition, item, target, query, and selected-response hashes to AUTHENTIC, CUT, TWIN, or SHAM and may change only the matched response bytes. Add separate projection/use text for each typed artifact and acquisition-derived adapter influence. Revise T03 so mutations outside a typed use preserve inputs, choices, errors, timing class, token accounting, condition survival, and outputs, while mutations inside the typed use may change only the declared boundary. Role, boundary, source kind, and quarantine predicates must reject the retained nominee itself before any equivalence lookup, including malformed or fault-injected states.

resolution.rationale: Permanent sterility is a local writer invariant, not a property that may rely only on upstream DREAM visibility. An ineligible observation must not influence even which eligible root is selected.

disagreements.issue: Whether D1C and D1D define prospective treatment regimes and all-assigned outcomes for every authentic DREAM and downstream writer status.

positions.position: One shared authentic output/lineage, a generic status table, no fallback, and MISSING/RUN_INVALID labels sufficiently define the branches.
Branch installation, debit, continuation, evidence-state, and reducer behavior remain undefined for empty, absent, invalid, slot-missing, overflow, and publication-failure products.

resolution.rationale: The shared authentic call is worth preserving, but output-dependent matching and allegedly decisive retained-slot cuts introduce unnecessary post-treatment complexity. D1C can identify total context-policy value without claim-bearing leave-one-out cuts, and D1D can compare total root-selection regimes without matching realized authentic dose.
resolution.selected_position: Use fixed total policy regimes: D1C authentic PUBLISH versus deterministic RECENCY_CONTEXT and presealed recipient-local PERMUTED_CONTEXT; D1D authentic DREAM_TO_SLEEP versus RECENCY_TO_SLEEP and HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP. Remove confirmatory D1C retained-slot CUT and output-matched D1D PUBLISH_CUT.
resolution.required_change: For each eligible pressure snapshot, execute exactly one charged authentic DREAM call shared by all D1C/D1D clones. D1C PUBLISH installs valid authentic output, installs the valid empty view for PUBLISH_EMPTY, and installs nothing for ABSTAIN or missing statuses; RECENCY_CONTEXT and PERMUTED_CONTEXT are pre-call recipient-local total selectors over the allowed snapshot with identical prospective allowance and execute regardless of authentic status. Remove D1C decisive-slot eligibility and CUT from the claim gate; any leave-one-out analysis is descriptive mediation only. D1D DREAM_TO_SLEEP uses only valid authentic retained nominations; RECENCY_TO_SLEEP selects eligible recipient roots in canonical reverse-commit order up to the fixed capacity; HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP selects from a presealed recipient-local hash order up to the same capacity. Controls never use authentic cardinality or donor output. Add a branch-by-status table specifying installed bytes or none, all debits, receipts, downstream execution, writer status, evidence state, and reducer input for every DREAM, projection, capacity, SLEEP, validation, and publication outcome. There is no retry, reassignment, fallback, or realized-dose matching.

disagreements.issue: Whether three donor-derived controls are necessary and whether donor assignment remains prospective when artifacts fail or are incompatible.

positions.position: Wrong-life adapters, D1C donor slot descriptors, and D1D donor ranks are typed cross-life payloads with no raw donor semantics.
Donor adapters are intentionally causally active, but construction order, success-conditioned availability, compatibility, and no-replacement failure behavior are not total.

resolution.rationale: Only wrong-life adapter specificity actually requires a donor life. Recipient-local presealed controls answer D1C/D1D without cross-life output generation, eliminating two attrition channels while preserving the intended contrasts.
resolution.selected_position: Delete D1C and D1D donor payloads; retain only one typed WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER import under prospective no-replacement donor assignment.
resolution.required_change: Replace D1C_MISMATCH and D1D_PUBLISH_MISMATCH donor schemas with the recipient-local PERMUTED_CONTEXT and HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP algorithms in R04. Define the WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER donor population from pre-model compatible life identities, assign donor identity to recipient by sealed seed before any donor model/training call, prohibit reuse/reciprocal pairs/cycles and adaptive replacement, and require identical base architecture, tokenizer, adapter shape, recipe family, and mount interface. A known inability to form the identity matching is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL before recipient assignment; an assigned donor's absent or failed adapter is MISSING and remains assigned; hash/shape incompatibility is RUN_INVALID. Raw donor ledgers, IDs, records, roots, answers, prompts, and workspace bytes remain forbidden, while the typed adapter weights may affect only READ scores as intended.

disagreements.issue: Whether all eight baselines, all cue families, cycling/down-selection, and active-retained-byte equality form one feasible claim-bearing comparison contract.

positions.position: Eight baseline cells are mandatory, reader READY is one pass without selection changes, trained D1A/D1B comparisons may cycle/down-select, and primary comparisons equal active retained bytes.
Those rules conflict; symbolic key selectors do not cover text-only cues; policy adapters are underdefined; and adapter-on versus adapter-off byte equality is infeasible without forbidden padding.

resolution.rationale: The primary causal claims compare treatments within the isolated reader/path system. Learned policy baselines are outside PPC5's frozen-policy thesis, and equalizing away the adapter bytes would equalize away part of the treatment itself.
resolution.selected_position: Use one-pass no-cycling READ training, delete DIRECT_ACTION_LORA and RAW_BATCH_LORA from PPC5, restrict exact-key LINKED_TEXT/EXPLICIT_GRAPH to EXACT/REVERSE, and report rather than equalize treatment-defining resource differences.
resolution.required_change: Make the PPC5 baseline set BASE_AGENT, FULL_CONTEXT, RAW_RAG, LINKED_TEXT, EXPLICIT_GRAPH, and READER_LORA, with ADAPTER_OFF_CANDIDATE_ONLY, WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER, READER_ROOT_SHUFFLE, recurrence controls, and response interventions as causal controls. Remove all PPC5 policy-LoRA renderers, mounts, training, and claims; learned decision comparison begins in PPC6. READY always trains every admitted canonical row exactly once with no cycling, down-selection, truncation, oversampling, or padding. LINKED_TEXT and EXPLICIT_GRAPH run only EXACT and REVERSE: full-scan zero key matches returns NOT_FOUND, one returns FOUND, and more than one is pre-model CONSTRUCTION_FAIL; PARAPHRASE/PARTIAL are outside those two cells rather than silently mapped. RAW_RAG covers all four cue families. D1A core release depends on READER_LORA, ADAPTER_OFF, WRONG_LIFE, ROOT_SHUFFLE, false-memory, and abstention gates; exact symbolic cells are labeled reference ceilings and gate only explicitly claimed noninferiority. D1B release depends on READER_LORA, BASE_AGENT, FULL_CONTEXT constructibility, path interventions, and recurrence controls. Remove active-retained-byte equality as a causal gate; require complete inclusive and marginal resource manifests and treat adapter size, realized rows/tokens/updates, latency, and cost as treatment dose/outcomes. No fake padding is permitted.

disagreements.issue: Whether status labels plus a later freely chosen life_reducer define the intended life-level ITT estimands and claimwise error control.

positions.position: Every unit contributes to a life value, while aggregation functions, transforms, status mappings, and multiplicity may be populated in the later run lock.
Those choices define the estimand and promotion probability and therefore must be architecture-bound; MISSING cannot be excluded or arbitrarily imputed.

resolution.rationale: Analysis algorithms are part of the scientific architecture. Numeric instantiation may be deferred, but status semantics, endpoint hierarchy, denominator rules, bounds, and family membership may not.
resolution.selected_position: Bind exhaustive per-assay ITT reducers and a closed claim family before ratification; use conservative bounds for MISSING and block on construction or integrity failures.
resolution.required_change: Define one closed reducer for each D1A-D1D contrast with a prospectively constructed recipient-life roster as denominator and every assigned lower-level unit represented exactly once. CONSTRUCTION_FAIL blocks the dependent claim before execution; any RUN_INVALID blocks it after execution. VALID_EMPTY or zero admitted roots remains an observed zero-dose regime outcome. MISSING stays flagged and the primary contrast uses worst-case bounds over each endpoint's architecture-declared finite range; a claim releases only if the adverse bound passes its later numeric margin and the later missingness limit. Bind target-population construction, nested clone/pair structure, deterministic aggregation order, metric transform, zero-eligible rule, branch/edge conjunction, and exact primary endpoints in the architecture. Put the four assay-release hypotheses in one Holm step-down family at later-bound alpha; within an assay, required component gates use intersection-union logic, so every named gate must pass. The finite label is a pure four-way conjunction and adds no standalone mediation test. Optional baseline and mediator analyses are explicitly exploratory and cannot release a core claim. The run lock may set life count, seeds, assignment probabilities within fixed domains, alpha, margins, thresholds, power inputs, numeric budgets/capacities, endpoint range constants, and missingness limit, but may not change algorithms or family membership. Add golden reducer vectors for every status and boundary case.

disagreements.issue: Whether unique-path, twin/sham, ONE_SHOT_QUERY, and OPEN_LOOP prose determines identical independent static instruments.

positions.position: Prospective length-2/3 unique paths, every-edge interventions, and descriptive recurrence ablations provide sufficient construction intent.
Enumeration, alias handling, feasibility, parity, call schedules, state exposure, invalid operations, and debit behavior are not deterministic algorithms.

resolution.rationale: Every-edge necessity is the strongest part of D1B, but attribution requires the intervention and recurrence controllers to change only their named mechanism and to be independently sealable.
resolution.selected_position: Retain D1B, but bind a canonical graph oracle, token-parity twins, solution-invariant shams, and exact minimal-operation schedules.
resolution.required_change: Construct a directed multigraph only from admitted direct public atoms after target-blind alias canonicalization. Enumerate all simple directed paths of length at most the locked READ budget in lexicographic edge-ID order; require exactly one action-decisive minimal path of length two or three and no other action-sufficient path or subset, otherwise CONSTRUCTION_FAIL. Target prompt/action bytes and all target handles must be source-disjoint by hash. A TWIN must preserve the response schema, byte-length class, locked-token count, logical debit, and allowance while replacing only the registered directional binding; otherwise construction fails. SHAM must target a nonpath response whose substitution is certified by the sealed truth oracle to preserve the registered action. For a path of length L, AUTHENTIC permits exactly L interleaved READ calls followed by exactly one PREDICT and one ACT call. ONE_SHOT_QUERY permits exactly L READ-planning calls with prior request bytes but no returns visible, then appends all returns in request order, then permits one PREDICT and one ACT. OPEN_LOOP permits the same L READ-planning calls plus PREDICT and ACT commitment with no returns or outcomes visible, then executes returns and the committed action and permits no later call. Any wrong operation, absent call, parse error, budget error, or extra call maps through one bound status table and remains ITT. Golden vectors must cover every edge, alias, alternate path, parity failure, invalid schedule, debit, error, and terminal replay.
